## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`. One helper writes a complete `layout`; the casts go

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T15:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** Three named producers store a widget `layout` the spec refuses, on a widget with none, and the casts hide it from the type checker.

**Direction.**
- One shared helper completes the `layout`: it seeds `x` and `y` (and the other dimension) from the widget's current grid placement, else from the grid's default. All three writers call it.
- ⛔ No three local copies, and ⛔ no casts past the declared type.
- **Pin:** editing the width of a widget with no `layout` stores a four-number `layout` that the spec parses, on each of the three surfaces. A widget that has a `layout` keeps its `x` and `y` (the control).

## Claim amendment: `Clause-②` → `yes` (the helper is a new export), and the surface widens to the grid's auto-placement and the displayed box

`domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42` · 2026-10-01T19:28Z. This amends the claim `5937062361`, whose line-start `Clause-②:` key now reads `yes`. The state and assignee are unchanged. ⛔ Not a new claim. Dev report on this card, PR objectui#11398.

- **`Clause-②: yes`** (the dev's open question, option A). The claim's `no` was conditional on the shared helper not becoming a new export, and it did: `@object-ui/types` gains `completeWidgetLayout` and `defaultWidgetPlacement` on its main entry. That enlarges the published surface. It is `minor`, as declared, on the precedent of `.changeset/10183-date-only-shared-parse-step.md`. An at-tier contract review is owed before the queue.
- **Surface beyond the claim, judged in scope:**
  - `packages/types/src/dashboard-widget-layout.ts` (new) and `packages/types/src/index.ts` (the export). This is the helper's home: all three writers already import `@object-ui/types`, so there is no new dependency edge.
  - `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx`: the grid's auto-placement now uses the same `defaultWidgetPlacement`, so the grid and the editors cannot disagree. Where widgets land does not change.
  - The width / height inputs (and `DashboardWithConfig`'s sliders) show the completed box, so the dimension an edit leaves alone is the one on screen. A widget with no `layout` now displays 3 × 4 where it displayed 1 × 1. This is a visible change, named in the changeset and the PR body.
  - One existing pin in `DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx` changed its edit value, because 4 is now the displayed value.
  - The `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `packages/types/README.md` lines.
  - All NOT GOVERNED.
- **PR body:** the dev, as instructed, wrote no `Clause-②` line, and the seat adds `Clause-②: yes` as its second line in this act.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a831be792e94ec4e0b47fe0c49505f29536801ad`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11388 (body; triage `5935208354`; claim `5937062361`, whose `Clause-②:` line now reads `yes`; dev report `5938910423`; seat amendment `5938976750`), PR objectui#11398 (body, 15-file list, net diff `origin/main...` at the head, read with git on the existing clone, no checkout), the head's check-runs, and the published `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 source read from the npm registry tarball (`src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, shasum `4c4e8147…`). Nothing was built, run or re-run.

Check-runs on the head, read at 19:37Z with every run completed (the last at 19:36:00Z): 43 check-runs; 40 success, 3 skipped by design (dependabot, the two coverage jobs), 0 failure, 0 in progress. All eight `Test` shards and the `Test` rollup, `Test (dist pins)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `README Export Check`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Line Citation Gate` are green. The combined status is success (Vercel). Nothing was re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**The two new main-entry exports of `@object-ui/types`.** `packages/types/src/dashboard-widget-layout.ts` is new and `src/index.ts` adds one export line (`completeWidgetLayout`, `defaultWidgetPlacement`). Both return the declared `DashboardWidgetLayout` from `complex.ts` (`x`, `y`, `w`, `h`, four required numbers), and the module's only import is `import type` of that interface, so it is zod-free and React-free at runtime, which is the main entry's stated contract (the `./zod` subpath carries the validators). All three writers already carry `@object-ui/types` in `dependencies` (`workspace:*`), and plugin-designer does not depend on plugin-dashboard, so the helper's home adds no dependency edge. Correct.

**`defaultWidgetPlacement` is the spec's stated auto-placement.** The published 17.5.0 source says, on the widget `layout` member: "when omitted, the renderer auto-flows the widget into the grid (DashboardGridLayout falls back to `x: (i % 4) * 3, y: Math.floor(i/4) * 4, w: 3, h: 4`). The Studio dashboard designer adds widgets WITHOUT a layout and relies on this auto-flow". The function returns exactly `{ x: (index % 4) * 3, y: Math.floor(index / 4) * 4, w: 3, h: 4 }`. It is also exactly what `DashboardGridLayout.buildDefaultLayouts` computed on `main` (`widget.layout?.x ?? (index % 4) * 3`, `?? Math.floor(index / 4) * 4`, `?? 3`, `?? 4`); the head's `...completeWidgetLayout(widget.layout, {}, defaultWidgetPlacement(index))` is the same per-coordinate `??` chain with the same values, so no widget lands anywhere else. No placement change. Correct.

**The three writers.** Studio's `DashboardWidgetInspector` (width and height inputs), `DashboardWithConfig`'s `handleWidgetFieldChange` (`layoutW` / `layoutH`) and `DashboardEditor`'s `WidgetPropertyPanel` (now handed the widget's `index`) each write `completeWidgetLayout(widget.layout, { w | h }, defaultWidgetPlacement(index))`, a whole four-number box. A census of the head finds zero remaining `as DashboardWidgetSchema['layout']` casts and zero remaining one-dimension spreads onto `layout` anywhere under `packages/`, and `DashboardWidgetSchema.layout` is declared `DashboardWidgetLayout | undefined`, so the compiler judges each write (CI `Type Check` green). A widget that has a `layout` keeps its `x` and `y`: `patch.x ?? layout?.x ?? placement.x`, pinned as the control on each of the three surfaces (`{ x: 6, y: 2, w: 3, h: 5 }` with the width edited to 4 stays `{ x: 6, y: 2, w: 4, h: 5 }`) and in the types pin. The width-edit pin on each surface parses the written widget with the spec's own `DashboardWidgetSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, which is the triage's pin spelled as asked. Correct.

**The visible change.** The inputs (and `DashboardWithConfig`'s sliders, which `WidgetConfigPanel` declares as `type: 'slider'`) now show the completed box, so a widget with no `layout` shows 3 × 4 where it showed 1 × 1, and `DashboardWithConfig`'s `selectedWidgetConfig` seeds `layoutW: 3`, `layoutH: 4` for an unresized layout-less widget, which `handleWidgetSave` hands to `onWidgetSave` verbatim. Right: the 1 × 1 was a fiction no renderer ever drew (the grid auto-places 3 × 4), and showing anything but the box the writer will store would make a width edit store `h: 4` while the height input still read 1, and in `DashboardWithConfig` make the live schema and the saved `layoutH` disagree. Disclosed three times: the changeset's last two paragraphs, the PR body's "What the inputs show", and the seat amendment. The one existing pin edited (`DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx`, the map-title round trip now edits height 2 instead of 4) is edited for exactly this reason and says so.

**The `DashboardRenderer` fallback span (the dev's out-of-scope note).** On `main` and on the head, `DashboardRenderer.renderWidget` gives a layout-less widget in the positioned grid `{ w: 3, h: 2 }` for a metric and `{ w: 6, h: 4 }` otherwise, under a comment claiming it is "matching the editable DashboardGridLayout's auto-placement", which it is not (the grid and the spec say 3 × 4 for every widget). This PR does not touch `DashboardRenderer`. Judgment: **exposed, not made worse.** Before the PR a width edit on a layout-less metric stored `{ w }`, and the dev measured the renderer then drawing `gridRow: span undefined`, so the metric already lost its 2-row height on the first edit, and the inspector showed 1 against a preview drawing 2 (metric) or 4 (other). After the PR the edit stores the spec-stated box and the preview draws it; the inspector-versus-preview disagreement for an UNEDITED layout-less widget shrinks (metric: width now agrees at 3, height 4 versus 2; other: height now agrees at 4, width 3 versus 6) but does not close, because its cause is the renderer's own type-dependent span, not this diff. It is a reproducible, visible inconsistency plus a false code comment, so it belongs on a card rather than only in acceptance notes; escalated under ③.

**One note, not a finding.** `completeWidgetLayout` types its `layout` parameter as a `Partial` of `DashboardWidgetLayout`, or `undefined`, wider than any typed caller supplies (all pass `DashboardWidgetLayout | undefined`), and the types pin exercises a stored `{ w: 6 }` being completed. This codifies the per-coordinate `??` the grid already applied on `main`; it adds no new tolerance on any authoring face (the spec still refuses `{ w }`), and its output is always spec-valid. It is the triage's own "else from the grid's default" and is accepted as such.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11388-widget-layout-complete.md` declares `@object-ui/types: minor`, and `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, `@object-ui/plugin-designer: patch`. That matches what the diff publishes: two new exports on a published package's main entry is an additive public-surface change, hence `minor`, which the rule "`Clause-②: yes` takes at least `minor`" requires and the cited precedent `.changeset/10183-date-only-shared-parse-step.md` (one new `@object-ui/core` export, `Clause-②: yes`, `minor`) grades the same way; the three consumers change behaviour only to stop writing a value the spec refuses, with `DashboardWithConfig`'s `onWidgetSave` keeping its flattened shape and changing only the two values that were fiction, hence `patch`. No `major` (`Changeset Bump Policy` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` green; the fixed group of 40 bumps `minor` together). `Clause-②: yes` is carried where the protocol reads it, the claim (amended at `5937062361`) and the PR body's second line; the changeset body carries no `Clause-②` line, which objectui does not require (no objectui gate reads it there, and 74 of 2571 pending changesets carry one by choice). The seat amendment's `Clause-②: yes` is upheld.

Every changeset sentence read against the diff:
- "each spread the one edited dimension onto the widget's possibly-absent `layout` and cast the result past the declared four-number type": true for all three on `main`, the app-shell writer included (`as DashboardWidgetSchema['layout']` removed in all three hunks).
- "On a widget with no `layout`, which is how Studio adds one": true, `DashboardPreview.handleAddWidget` builds `{ id, type, title, ...meta.defaults }` with no `layout`, no `WIDGET_TYPE_META` default carries one, and the spec's own comment says so.
- "`@objectstack/spec`'s widget `layout` refuses that box at `x`, `y` and the other dimension": true, pinned by the types test's premise block against 17.5.0.
- the two export descriptions and the `(i % 4) * 3` … `h: 4` formula: true, verbatim from the published spec source and the code.
- "All three editors now write through `completeWidgetLayout` … and the casts are gone": true (census above).
- "A widget that has a `layout` keeps its `x` and `y`": true, four controls.
- "The width and height inputs (and `DashboardWithConfig`'s sliders) show the same completed box … 3 × 4 where it showed 1 × 1": true (`value={layout.w}` / `layout.h`; `layoutW: layout.w` / `layoutH: layout.h`; both old spellings were `?? 1`).
- "`DashboardGridLayout` places a widget with no `layout` through `defaultWidgetPlacement`, with no change to where it lands": true (arithmetic identical).
- "`onWidgetSave` payload keeps its flattened `layoutW` / `layoutH` shape … now the auto-placed 3 and 4, not 1 and 1": true (`handleWidgetSave` passes the panel's config verbatim).

Doc and README lines: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` (one paragraph) and `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` (one paragraph) state the same facts accurately and name the two exports and their package. `packages/types/README.md` adds "Writing a widget's `layout`" with a snippet whose comment ("No `layout` at index 0 → `{ x: 0, y: 0, w: 6, h: 4 }`; an existing box keeps its x, y and h") matches the helper; the snippet's symbols are real (`README Export Check` green) and it type-checks (`Doc Snippet Type Check` green). No `path:line` citation in any added prose or comment (`Line Citation Gate` green).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` (Clause-②, options A/B): **answered.** A, as the seat amended; `minor` on `@object-ui/types`; upheld above.
- Deviation, closure build via `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`: process only; CI `Build & E2E` green. Accepted.
- Deviation, vitest narrowed after the 530 s cap: CI ran the full set; all eight `Test` shards, the `Test` rollup and `Test (dist pins)` are green on the head. Closed.
- Deviation, `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` touched beyond the three writers: judged in scope by the seat amendment; verified no placement change. Accepted.
- Deviation, inputs and sliders show the completed box, fixed in place rather than filed: a necessary half of the fix (the stored and shown box must be one box); disclosed in the changeset and PR body. Accepted.
- Deviation, the existing map-title pin edits height 2 instead of 4: justified and commented. Accepted.
- Deviation, Node v22 from `/opt/nvm`, engine-strict passed with no override: no contract effect. Accepted.
- Deviation, PR body written without a `Clause-②` line: resolved; the PR body now carries `Clause-②: yes` on its second line, added by the seat.
- NOT MEASURED, the server leg (Studio save, reload, validate against a backend), which the card named as the taker's first step: **escalated to the seat as a residual, not a landing condition.** The pins parse the written widget with the spec's own `DashboardWidgetSchema`, the contract the server validates against, so the shape is measured; what is unmeasured is the transport. The seat decides whether one dogfood pass post-merge closes it.
- `check:node-esm-load` exit 1 on turbo-cache provenance for `@object-ui/auth` and `@object-ui/react-runtime`, neither touched: an environment artefact, no CI check-run of that family failed. Accepted as NOT MEASURED for those two packages.
- Out-of-scope (a), `DashboardRenderer`'s fallback span (metric 3 × 2, other 6 × 4) versus the spec's 3 × 4, with a comment claiming parity: **escalated.** Exposed by this PR, not worsened (judged under ①). It is reproducible (a layout-less metric in the Studio preview draws 2 rows while the inspector reads Height 4, and a width edit changes that metric's drawn height from 2 to 4) and the comment is false, so it meets the bar for a card; the seat files it or records why not. The dev's "noted, not filed" is a dev-remit call this record overrides into the seat's hands.
- Out-of-scope (b), `onWidgetSave`'s flattened payload carries no `x` / `y` for a host to un-flatten: pre-existing shape, unchanged here, zero hosts in objectui or objectstack. Note stands; no action.
- Governed surface: the 15 paths touch none (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` green; no `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `NORTH-STAR.md` in the file list).
- Lint narrowed to the 11 changed files: CI `Lint` green over the full population. Accepted.
